title: January commentary
content: As always, we are deeply appreciative of our Editorial Board team and the amazingly thoughtful reviews they solicit from deeply committed ad hoc reviewers. We are so very pleased to announce the addition of seven new board members over the past year who add deep expertise and increase diversity from many perspectives. They are Carolina Diller (Sweden; agricultural ecology, plant reproductive ecology and evolution, heat stress and drought), Mojgan Chapariha (United Kingdom; economics, ecosystem services), Sarah Elmendorf (United States; data flow management, community ecology, large team research collaborations), Austin Himes (United States; relational values, forestry, forest ecology, silviculture, ecosystem services, and NPCs: nature, people, and climate), Anurag Dhyani (India; forest conservation, medicinal plants), Valter Azevado-Santos (Brazil; conservation biology, ichthyology), Marina Omacini (Argentina; grassland ecology, above- and belowground interactions, co-occurring symbioses, mycorrhizal ecology, grass–endophyte mutualisms, introduced species management), and Peter Edmunds (United States; corals and coral reef ecology, long-term ecological research). Thank you, and welcome aboard!
